Two friends went to write by the sea in the sun. The girl said, “My tale is about a witch and her son who rode down a road into a hole. I want to see your story too.” The boy said, “Mine is about a plain blue plane that blew right by, with a tail of smoke.” A friend came to meet them and brought some meat. “Write your whole stories in peace," he said. "Then, I’ll hear which piece I like best!" Dos amigos fueron a escribir junto al mar bajo el sol.
